== Notes ==
* This skill is invoked in GvG when [[Vine Seed]] is dropped and doesn't form a bridge.  After a delay of about two seconds, the seed sprouts and causes Entanglement on adjacent foes.
* This skill is also seen in certain [[Maguuma Jungle]] missions.
* This skill affects [[miniature]]s.
* The description reads "trapped" but means the game mechanic [[knock down]].
